 Adria Arjona was honored at the Women in Film’s WIF Honors party this week and she had the support of her boyfriend Jason Momoa while receiving the WIF Max Mara Face of the Future Award!
 The Onslaught actress stunned in a white gown while attending the event on Thursday night (November 5) at The Beverly Hilton in Beverly Hills, Calif. 
 Maria Giulia Prezioso Maramotti , the granddaughter of the Max Mara founder, presented the award to Adria . 
 36 Adria Arjona, in Max Mara 
 36 Adria Arjona and Jason Momoa 
 Adria paid tribute to some of the legendary actresses in attendance at the party, including Salma Hayek and Jane Fonda .
 “I’m here tonight because of the women who came before me, both in my family and in this industry. Jane and Salma, because of what you have endured and what you have fought for, and the doors that you have opened, I get to live my dreams,” she said in her speech. 
 36 Salma Hayek, in Bottega Veneta, and Jane Fonda, in Max Mara 
 36 Hannah Waddingham, in Max Mara 
 Salma was awarded the Jane Fonda Humanitarian Award, which the actress presented to her. 
 “I think we [women] were meant to be directors. We [Women] were meant to be producers. I think women are meant to be president,” Salma said in her speech.
 Ted Lasso ‘s Hannah Waddingham won The Crystal Award for Advocacy in TV, which was presented to her by Sharon Stone . 
 Hannah told the crowd that “as long as there is breath in my body, I will stand on the ladder in my incredibly fabulous high heels, wedge on the bottom rung, and give a hand to those who need it.”
